description: LWN Simulator is provided by University of Catania ARS Lab. LWN Simulator represents LoRaWAN devices, forwarders and gateways and can communicate with a real or ad-hoc LoRaWAN server environment such as ChirpStack. It includes a web interface and configurable node behaviour. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: MIT, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Support for some device classes is partial. Independent reuse and sustained maintenance beyond this project were not established. Potential simulation use: Test LoRaWAN server interactions with synthetic node populations. For catalogue navigation, platform-ns-3 offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
